resolution: The generic 20-50 treatment / 20-50 control target was replaced by the existing owner-reviewed PTI-DA-001 design: 12 treatment entities and 6 controls from the current published universe, with no new indexable URLs. The site-specific freeze is authoritative because Ptichi's binding expansion gate and stale production deployment make artificial cohort expansion inappropriate.
purpose: Historical generic planning input for a bounded Search/AI discovery cohort. The authoritative executable cohort is now the site-specific freeze referenced above.

design.assignment: Generic pre-site-review target only. The resolved Ptichi cohort must not be enlarged to meet these counts.

treatmentRequirements: The page solves a real user task and is useful without machine-readable metadata.
The page has stable canonical identity and is not a thin keyword/filter variant.
Visible facts and machine-readable facts remain in parity.
The intervention is recorded precisely enough to distinguish it from unrelated site changes.
Related entities/pages are linked only when the relationship helps the user.
Evidence/provenance is shown when a claim depends on external research or a real dataset.

requiredBeforeTreatment: Google page/query visibility export when available
baseline.missingEvidencePolicy: Unknown remains unknown; do not convert missing owner data into zero.

outcomes: time-to-index where owner evidence supports it
top-10 persistence for fixed observed cohorts
stopConditions: Treatment pages become less useful or misleading to users.
A material confounder prevents an interpretable comparison and cannot be isolated.
The intervention requires synthetic claims, fake reviews/experience or unsupported structured data.
Repeated neutral/negative observations make scale-up unjustified.
nextExecution: Use the authoritative site-specific controlled cohort freeze.
Keep its measurement gate on HOLD until production evidence matches the frozen implementation ref.
After deployment parity, capture repeated fixed-panel and owner-side observations at the declared windows.
Feed reviewed treatment/control outcomes back into Goose Recommendation Review without automatic promotion.
